authority_hierarchy.rule: Temporal neighbors control motion and contacts only and never replace design or proportion authority.

identity_lock.silhouette: Large rounded navy beret, matte ash-beige bob, compact navy A-line dress, short sturdy legs, one canonical tan satchel and one small rabbit retain the approved silhouette through vertical landing compression.
identity_lock.proportions: Preserve the broad face and head, approximately four-head-tall compact body, torso thickness, limb volume, garment length, sock cylinders, shoe size and final foot spacing of the standing authority.
identity_lock.face_and_markings: Soft rounded pale face, muted blue-gray eyes and fixed fringe; only a restrained impact blink and recovery gaze may change.
identity_lock.costume: Deep navy beret and dress, cream collar and lace hem, orange ribbon, three brass buttons, canonical strap route, viewer-right satchel, one rabbit, cream socks and black Mary Jane shoes keep exact topology.
identity_lock.rendering: Soft polished anime game sprite with fine dark outlines, restrained warm cel shading, matte subdued hair highlights, smooth navy fabric, fixed orthographic camera and neutral light.

action_contract.intent: She descends slightly, contacts an invisible window top with both shoes, absorbs the landing through knees and hips, steadies her weight and returns to the approved neutral stance.
action_contract.allowed_motion: Vertical root travel inside the cell; ankle, knee and hip flexion; small torso counter-tilt; restrained balancing arms and eyelid reaction; plausible hair, hem, strap, satchel and rabbit follow-through.
action_contract.forbidden_changes: No horizontal travel, step, visible platform, umbrella, scenery, shadow, interpolation, morph, warp, part composite, body slimming, face-size drift, brighter hair, thinner legs, shorter dress, rerouted strap, detached or duplicated bag/rabbit, crop, text or watermark.

contact_ledger.contact_points: first sole contact at frame 3; both planted through frame 10; one sole may briefly unweight at a time during the tiny inward stance adjustment at frames 11-13; both planted again at frame 14

contact_ledger.occlusion_order: rabbit in front of satchel; satchel in front of viewer-right skirt/leg where canonical

threshold_notes.baseline_lock: Disabled because the airborne root descends and the impact pose compresses vertically inside the fixed cell.
threshold_notes.max_area_drift: Deep but controlled foreshortening changes the visible silhouette; local head, face, limb and costume checks remain mandatory.
threshold_notes.max_bbox_aspect_drift: Raised narrowly from 0.80 to 0.85 for the declared F05 deep impact-compression silhouette, where bent knees, a widened hem and the balancing forearm legitimately widen the figure; local proportion QA remains mandatory.
threshold_notes.max_center_range_px: The character moves vertically inside the cell while the pivot remains fixed.

user_approval.verdict: 应该已经完成了，可以验收并且接入godot 并分阶段提交了。

frames.pose: slight airborne descent above the final contact plane
both shoe soles first contact the same invisible horizontal plane
root lowers and skirt begins to widen
deepest controlled impact absorption with both soles planted
compression holds only through timing while secondary motion overtakes
half-rise stabilized pose with eyes reopened
viewer-left shoe unweights slightly and begins a tiny inward stance adjustment
viewer-left shoe replants while the opposite shoe begins closing inward
both shoes settle at canonical spacing while the restrained rebound reaches its final tiny peak
independently redrawn approved neutral standing endpoint
